description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecSystemRunCommandValidator component, which validates system run commands against a predefined contract. It includes test cases, fixtures loading, and validation logic to ensure command resolution behaves correctly under various scenarios.

classes.name: ExecSystemRunCommandValidatorTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the correctness of system run command validation logic, including contract loading and various command scenarios.
